"/></div></div><div class="wrap">

<section class="slide tint" id="advisors"><div class="wrap">
<p class="eyebrow">06 / The advisory architecture</p>
<h2>Not famous names on a page.<br class="dsk"/> <em>Builders in the room.</em></h2>
<p class="intro">A small council of founders, operators and dealmakers chosen for the work ahead, each with a defined purpose and pay that follows contribution.</p>
<p class="hint">Select a card to see the fit, the role and the proof of contribution.</p>
<div class="domains">
<details class="domain"><summary><span class="idx">01 / Media &amp; entertainment</span><h3>Build a media company, not just a channel.</h3></summary>
<div class="body"><ul class="bul">
<li><strong>Fit:</strong> media founder, distribution builder or talent-agency principal, including an agent who can negotiate with managers and talent for StarNews</li>
<li><strong>Recruiting:</strong> senior founders with industry relationships, assessed against the mandate before any introduction</li>
<li><strong>Proof of contribution:</strong> a media expansion thesis, qualified talent and agency introductions, a concrete deal pathway</li>
</ul></div></details>
<details class="domain"><summary><span class="idx">02 / Creator economy &amp; talent</span><h3>Make creator success repeatable.</h3></summary>
<div class="body"><ul class="bul">
<li><strong>Fit:</strong> founder of a creator platform, talent business or artist and sports venture who understands recruitment, incentives and retention</li>
<li><strong>Scope:</strong> music is established; sports and original digital creators widen the opportunity</li>
<li><strong>Proof of contribution:</strong> a creator acquisition and retention model, incentive experiments, partner introductions</li>
</ul></div></details>
<details class="domain"><summary><span class="idx">03 / Content &amp; IP</span><h3>Turn a library into an asset.</h3></summary>
<div class="body"><ul class="bul">
<li><strong>Fit:</strong> founder or owner of a production, licensing or rights business that has built and monetized a catalog</li>
<li><strong>With Philippe:</strong> extend the production, contracts and rights work already underway</li>
<li><strong>Proof of contribution:</strong> a rights inventory, catalog economics, priority licensing opportunities, an ownership strategy</li>
</ul></div></details>
<details class="domain"><summary><span class="idx">04 / AI-native transformation</span><h3>Redesign the operating machine.</h3></summary>
<div class="body"><ul class="bul">
<li><strong>Fit:</strong> founder who has run AI-led operations in a live business, with implementation specialists where needed</li>
<li><strong>Role:</strong> review RampRate’s operating brief and vendor assessment, challenge technical assumptions and guide the approved pilot. RampRate owns the assessment; the selected implementation team builds.</li>
<li><strong>Proof of contribution:</strong> a documented technical review, guidance at pilot checkpoints, an evidence-based scale recommendation</li>
</ul></div></details>
</div>
<div class="calib">
<h3>Involvement fits the role. Founders come first.</h3>
<ul class="bul">
<li>Core strategic advisors: about four hours a month, with rollover</li>
<li>Senior founders valued for judgment and access: about two hours</li>
<li class="widow-advisor">Hands-on builders in AI, talent deals, content/IP and enterprise: separately scoped, more intensive or transaction-based&nbsp;mandates</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div></section>
